package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

type InitialAllocationCheckpoint struct {
	StudentID        string                  `json:"student_id"`
	RequestID        string                  `json:"request_id"`
	DiagnosticPlanID string                  `json:"diagnostic_plan_id"`
	Replacement      LearningPathReplacement `json:"replacement"`
	Reused           bool                    `json:"reused"`
}

func (c InitialAllocationCheckpoint) Validate(request CoursePlanRequest) error {
	if c.StudentID != request.StudentID || c.RequestID != request.ID || c.DiagnosticPlanID != request.DiagnosticPlanID || c.DiagnosticPlanID == "" || request.Intent.Source != PlanningSourceTeacher || request.Intent.Reason != PlanningReasonInitial || c.Replacement.PlanningRequestID != request.ID || c.Replacement.GoalCode != request.GoalCode || c.Replacement.ExpectedVersion != 0 || c.Replacement.ReasonCode != "initial_plan" {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if !validCoursePlanUUID(c.Replacement.CourseID) || c.Replacement.CourseFingerprint == "" || len(c.Replacement.CourseFingerprint) > 128 || strings.TrimSpace(c.Replacement.CourseFingerprint) != c.Replacement.CourseFingerprint || c.Replacement.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || len(c.Replacement.PlannerPolicyVersion) > 64 || strings.TrimSpace(c.Replacement.PlannerPolicyVersion) != c.Replacement.PlannerPolicyVersion || c.Replacement.ReasonSummary == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(c.Replacement.ReasonSummary) > 500 || c.Replacement.ExpectedOnboardingVersion < 1 || c.Replacement.ExpectedDirectionCode == "" || normalizeCode(c.Replacement.ExpectedDirectionCode) != c.Replacement.ExpectedDirectionCode || len(c.Replacement.ExpectedDirectionCode) > 64 || len(c.Replacement.Items) == 0 || len(c.Replacement.Items) > 500 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	_, err := normalizeLearningPathItems(c.Replacement.Items, false)
	return err
}

func InitialAllocationHash(c InitialAllocationCheckpoint) (string, error) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(c)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}
